defects.rationale: The caller-supplied `name` is interpolated into the SQL literal on this line, so a value like `' OR '1'='1' --` terminates the quoted string and alters the WHERE clause, leaking or destroying rows when the built string is executed on line 3.

issues.observation: The rationale cites line 2 for the interpolation but attributes execution to line 3; if the execution call is itself a separate defect (e.g., unparameterized execute or missing error handling), it is not reported as its own finding.
